title: Meniscal Repair

positions.as_written: Assess the effusion, because a recurrent effusion after the early weeks suggests the repair has not healed.
Measure the range, recording flexion, since deep flexion is restricted early and should recover.
Defer the meniscal provocation tests until the protected period has passed, and record that decision.
Assess for a mechanical block, since a failed repair can displace.
